basis.method: Transcript-first semantic review. Exact title similarity alone is not accepted as evidence. FULL means the transcript teaches the card scope; MIXED means multiple source lectures are genuinely required; PARTIAL means useful overlap but insufficient primary coverage; NOT_COVERED means the selected primary corpus does not teach the card.

rules: Do not replace current source for PARTIAL/NOT_COVERED without a verified secondary transcript.
MIXED cards should be split or represented as a source series rather than pretending one video covers the full card.
The same video may legitimately map to multiple cards only when its transcript explicitly covers each card.
Mathematics corpus is incomplete (13 transcripts for 29 cards); missing cards are intentionally not guessed.
